_readme: Drink photo groups for the home gallery and Pairings and sides menu. Each group has a photo, an honest type/exact caption, the current catalogue products and required attribution. photo=type is a representative drink, never a claim that it pictures the branded product; photo=exact must show the same product/variant and name it in shows. Source records and CC BY/BY-SA credits are required. Every catalogue drink must belong to exactly one group; the build enforces this. Removing a product requires removing it from both catalogue.json and these groups. Files are made by scripts/make_drink_photos.py; docs/credits.md records their licences and data/photo-alts.json their descriptions.
